subject: Closure sprint checkpoint: Crescent Therapeutics MAP & legal sequencing
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Closure sprint checkpoint: Crescent Therapeutics MAP & legal sequencing

Team —

Opening this thread to lock the mutual action plan (MAP) and identify any legal/procurement blockers that will affect our target close window (end of May). Key context: Crescent Therapeutics has greenlit a 6-week evaluation with production data ingress for pilot use. Procurement is asking for a clear sequencing of MSA/DPA/order form steps and an estimate for when a PO can land.

Ask: can we lay out a short, concrete sequencing table and owners for each lane (legal, security, procurement, pilot run) and confirm the absolute blocking items? I'm particularly worried about the DPA redlines (data retention + subprocessors) and the order form's billing language.

Initial attachments: Crescent-MAP-v1.xlsx (proposed milestones) and Crescent-security-questions.pdf (their initial security questionnaire).

Proposed quick wins:
- Confirm evaluation start date and data isolation for pilot (owner: Jonas)
- Pull the latest MSA that we want to ship to Crescent (owner: Karthik)
- Draft order form with pricing and PO terms for procurement (owner: Vanessa)
- Triage Crescent security asks that map to our SOC2/KMS answers (owner: Grace)

I'll coordinate a 30-min checkpoint with Crescent procurement/legal once we have owners assigned. Can everyone reply with any hard blockers and whether the attached MAP works as a starting point?

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Closure sprint checkpoint: Crescent Therapeutics MAP & legal sequencing

Thanks Grace — good framing. I took a pass and sketched a tentative sequencing and dates (see inline). I also attached a short MAP-proposal.pdf that tightens the milestone owners. High level comments:

- Legal: We'll push the "MSA_latest.pdf" with our standard security exhibits. Karthik, can you confirm whether we should surface the enhanced KMS wording for Crescent's EU data subset?
- DPA: Crescent's retention ask looks stricter than our standard. If legal gives a waiver path, procurement will accept with a short-term carveout for the pilot.
- Order form: procurement needs a PO-friendly billing clause (net30 + supplier remittance), and they prefer line-item reciprocity for termination liabilities. I can have a draft order_form_draft.docx by EOD tomorrow.
- Pilot acceptance: Jonas, confirm we can set the acceptance criteria to automated test coverage + functional demo by week 4. If not, we need to adjust the MAP.

Suggested milestone calendar (draft):
- Week 0 (Apr 12): Pilot kickoff + data access established (Jonas)
- Week 1–2: Security questionnaire deep-dive (Grace + Security team)
- Week 2–3: Legal redlines exchanged (Karthik + Crescent legal)
- Week 3–4: Pilot execution (Jonas)
- Week 4: Acceptance demo & sign-off prep (Grace)
- Week 5: PO expected; sign by Week 6 (target close end of May)

Hard blockers: SOC2 Type II report availability (we have it, but need to confirm dated report and scope) and any non-standard subprocessor requests.

I can own the order form draft and procurement lane. Attaching MAP-proposal.pdf.

—Vanessa

From: Mira Lawson <mira.lawson@crescenttx.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Park <sofia.park@crescenttx.com>, procurement@crescenttx.com
Date: 2027-04-04T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Closure sprint checkpoint: Crescent Therapeutics MAP & legal sequencing

Hi Grace & team — thanks for the proactive plan. Quick clarifications from Crescent Procurement/Legal:

1) Evaluation: We are comfortable with a 6-week pilot but need clarity on data residency and a narrow scope for PHI handling. Our security lead (Sofia Park) is CC'd and will send a short addendum to the questionnaire.
2) Data retention: For the pilot we request a 90-day retention cap with automatic purge after acceptance; this is stricter than your standard DPA.
3) Subprocessors: We need visibility on the list and a 30-day notice for any changes.
4) Timeline: Procurement target is PO submission by May 20. Legal will aim to return redlines within 5 business days after receiving your MSA draft.

Can you send the latest MSA and a draft order form so our team can circulate internally? Also, we prefer a single consolidated call next Tuesday (Apr 13) at 10am ET to walk the MAP and align owners. Availability note: I can join, Sofia may join for the first 30 min.

Requested attachments from Redwood: MSA_latest.pdf, order_form_draft.docx, SOC2 summary.

Thanks —
Mira Lawson
Sr. Manager, Procurement
Crescent Therapeutics

Subject: Re: Closure sprint checkpoint: Crescent Therapeutics MAP & legal sequencing

Mira / Sofia — thanks for the clarity. We're aligned to the Apr 13 call at 10am ET. Action items and owners below; I'll circulate a one-pager and calendar invite with the dial-in.

Action items (owners / target dates):
- Redwood to share MSA_latest.pdf + SOC2 summary + list of subprocessors (owner: Karthik) — by Apr 6 EOD
- Redwood to produce order_form_draft.docx (owner: Vanessa) — by Apr 5 EOD (Vanessa is already on it)
- Redwood Security (Grace) to respond to Crescent-security-questions.pdf and confirm 90-day retention feasibility for the pilot — by Apr 9
- Jonas to validate pilot acceptance criteria and data isolation architecture — by Apr 9
- Crescent to return initial legal redlines within 5 business days after Apr 6 (Sofia)

Related links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/DEAL-2027-0782) and I will send the DocuSign routing link once order form is locked (https://www.docusign.com/link/abc123).

If all of the above lands on cadence, procurement's PO target of May 20 is achievable; we should build contingency for a one-week slip and update the MAP accordingly.

I'll follow up with the Apr 13 invite and attach an updated Crescent-MAP-v2.xlsx after Karthik shares the MSA.

Best —
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
